title: Zorzal Inversiones Tecnológicas completed a purchase of shares of Arkano Software | User | ridgwayrecord.com
text:
CDI Global Latin America acted as Arkano M&A advisors during this transaction
MONTEVIDEO, Uruguay - April 23, 2025 - PRLog -- Zorzal Inversiones Tecnológicas S.A., a Uruguayan company listed on the Montevideo Stock Exchange (BVM), announced the acquisition of a Minority portion of the stock package of Arkano Software, a technology company with more than 18 years of experience in the region, specializing in the implementation of Microsoft solutions, with operations in Latin America.
CDI Global Latin America led by Daniel Boutmy, Martin Arocena and Martin Etcheverry, acted as Arkano M&A advisors during this Process, supporting in all relevant aspects, delivering a successful and optimal outcome for Arkano Software.
According to Zorzal's statement, Arkano operates in markets such as Argentina, Chile, Peru, Uruguay, Colombia, Paraguay, Ecuador, Nicaragua, and El Salvador. Furthermore, the company "has been recognized eight times as Microsoft Partner of the Year for its leadership in the adoption of technologies such as Microsoft 365, Azure, and Dynamics 365.
Arkano Software is a company with over 18 years of experience in the region, specializing in the implementation of Microsoft solutions.
"The team, comprised of more than 100 professionals, works with companies in strategic sectors such as energy, finance, oil & gas, pharmaceuticals, and retail. It stands out for its close focus and ongoing work with large corporate clients, combining daily support with long-term strategic planning," he added.
This acquisition is "particularly relevant given the international track record and growth prospects we found in Arkano Software. We were very impressed by the quality of its management and technical team, and its long history of working as a partner for a platform of the magnitude of Microsoft," said Jaime Miller, director of the Capital Oriental firm (which manages Zorzal's business).
Arkano Software emphasized that this investment strengthens its capacity to continue innovating and expanding its presence in the region. The addition of Zorzal as a strategic partner reinforces its sustainable growth and enables the generation of new business opportunities in the technology ecosystem.
